			NOT = { exists = scope:actor.faith.religious_head }
		}
		custom_tooltip = qpq_temple_patronage_hub_tt
		open_interaction_window = {
			interaction = qpq_temple_patronage_interaction
			actor = root
			recipient = scope:recipient
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = qpq_hub.back
		trigger_event = qpq_hub.1
	}
	option = {
		name = qpq_hub.cancel
	}
}
